Galen Winsor was a nuclear chemist who spent 15 years at the Hanford Site helping extract plutonium, later working in nuclear fuel reprocessing before retiring in 1986. In retirement, he became a vocal critic of federal radiation regulations, arguing that the risks of low-level radiation exposure were overstated.

candidates.source_title: After 22 Years, Her Former Love Sat Across From Her #history #art
candidates.source_description:
In 2010, Marina Abramović sat silently across from strangers for 736 hours at MoMA during The Artist Is Present.

Then Ulay — her former partner and artistic collaborator — took the seat across from her.

They hadn't seen each other in 22 years.

What happened next became one of the most unforgettable moments in performance art.
